title.value: Electroreductive Carboxylation of Propargylic Acetates with { \mathsf { C O } } _ { 2 } { \mathrm { : } } : Access to Tetrasubstituted 2,3-Allenoates

abstract.value: An electroreductive carboxylation of propargylic alcohols with $\mathrm { C O } _ { 2 }$ and then workup with TMSCHN to construct tetrasubstituted 2,3-allenoates is developed. This method allows the incorporation of an external ester group into the resulting allene system through electroreduction, carboxylation, and deacetoxylation cascades.
